name: Chocolate Cream Choux Wreath
subtitle: A crisp ring of choux pastry with chocolate glaze and liqueur cream
description: Bake a choux pastry ring, split it once cool, and fill it with lightly flavored whipped cream before finishing with chocolate glaze and optional decorations.

ingredients.item: unsalted butter chopped into small cubes
flaked toasted almonds gold pearls and icing sugar
Baileys or another Irish cream liqueur
Baileys or another Irish cream liqueur

instructions.text: Heat the milk, 75 g chopped unsalted butter, and caster sugar in a saucepan until the butter melts and the mixture reaches a boil.
Remove from the heat, add the flour, and beat until a smooth dough forms. Return to low heat and stir for about 2 minutes, until the dough pulls away from the pan.
Beat the eggs together, then add them gradually, mixing after each addition until the dough is smooth and glossy.
Pipe or spoon the dough into a ring on a lined baking sheet, leaving the center open.
Bake the wreath for 40 minutes, until well risen and golden. Cool completely before splitting it horizontally.

Melt the chocolate with 15 g butter and 100 ml cream over gentle heat or in short microwave intervals, stirring until smooth. Whisk in 1 tablespoon liqueur, then set aside until thick enough to spread.
Whip 300 ml cream with 50 ml liqueur, vanilla, and icing sugar until it holds soft peaks. Spoon or pipe the cream into the wreath and replace the top.
Spread or drizzle the chocolate mixture over the wreath. Finish with the optional almonds, gold pearls, and icing sugar, then serve.
